$comment: What deploy/configure.mjs generates and deploy/release.mjs deploys. `workers` is in dependency order: callees before callers (viz-ruler calls viz-query, viz-ingest and viz-control; viz-mcp calls viz-query, viz-control and viz-ruler; viz-gateway calls all of them). Promotion follows this order; rollback goes the other way.

shared_vars.$comment: Deployment-wide values every Worker must agree on. Applied to each Worker whose own config declares the var; a differing component value is overridden and reported.

script_aliases.$comment: Names components use today for the write-path script. All of them are viz-ingest.

workers.name: viz-publisher
workers.reason: Not wired in yet: the publisher reads the ledger's segments and is nudged by the maintenance run, but stack/ does not bind PUBLISHER, so nothing would reach it. When ingest binds it, it deploys before viz-ingest (callees first).
